legal.notConfigured: Not provided by the instance administrator.
legal.name: Name
legal.controllerText: The data controller is the administrator of this Cocotte instance, as identified in the legal notice. To exercise your rights or ask any question about your data: {contact}.
dataItems: Account: username, email address, password (stored hashed).
Preferences: diet, activity level, allergies and intolerances (see health data below).
Content you create: recipes, comments, ratings, meal plans, shopping lists, shares.
Technical data: last login date, used to apply the retention period below.
legal.purposesText: Your data is used only to run the service: authentication and account management (contract), recipes, planning, shopping lists and nutrition features (contract), and personalisation based on diet, activity and allergies (your explicit consent). It is neither sold nor used for advertising or profiling.
legal.healthText: Allergies, intolerances, diet and activity level may reveal information about your health or beliefs. They are processed only with your explicit consent, given at sign-up or later in My account, and recorded with its date, and are used only to personalise your use of Cocotte: excluding recipes that don't suit you from search results, warning you if a recipe added to your planner contains an allergen, and computing your nutrition alerts. You can withdraw this consent at any time in My account; doing so erases this data.
legal.retentionText: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Deleting your account erases it permanently.
legal.retentionInactive: Accounts with no login for {days} days are deleted, after an email warning sent beforehand.
legal.recipientsText: Data is accessible only to the instance administrators and to the host named in the legal notice. Recipes you publish are visible to other users and visitors. No data is sent to advertising or analytics services.
legal.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, to object to its processing and to withdraw your consent. Most of these are available directly in My account: edit your profile, "Export my data", withdraw consent, "Delete my account". Otherwise, write to {contact}.
legal.cookiesText: Cocotte uses no tracking or advertising cookies. Only strictly necessary storage is used in your browser (login tokens, language and appearance, offline cache), so no cookie banner is required.
legal.complaintText: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: www.cnil.fr).
